text:
mira: Heads up — hitting a nasty client-side congestion pattern in the onboarding sampleapp after token refresh. 401 -> refresh -> immediate retry floods the pagination loop and we see a big burst of 429s from /v1/embeds/batch. repro steps and logs below.

sam: Can you paste minimal repro steps? I can try locally.

mira: Steps: 1) run sampleapp with prefetch enabled (default). 2) revoke STS shortly after warmup to force refresh. 3) trigger a user scroll that causes 6 concurrent page fetches (cursor pages). 4) observe many retries and then 429s.

alejandra: That sounds like the SDK replay logic is re-sending inflight paginated requests with the same cursor concurrently after refresh, so backend sees them as independent and rate-limits. Could be missing coalescing/dedupe.

chao: Do you have logs? pattern I expect: `401` -> `POST /auth/refresh` -> many `POST /v1/embeds/batch` with same cursor within 10-50ms.

mira: Logs (sanitized):
```
[2026-02-18T16:03:02Z] 401 POST /v1/embeds/batch cursor=abc123 client_req_id=xyz
[2026-02-18T16:03:02Z] POST /auth/refresh status=200 new_token=***
[2026-02-18T16:03:02Z] RETRY POST /v1/embeds/batch cursor=abc123 client_req_id=xyz-1
[2026-02-18T16:03:02Z] RETRY POST /v1/embeds/batch cursor=abc123 client_req_id=xyz-2
[2026-02-18T16:03:02Z] 429 POST /v1/embeds/batch cursor=abc123
```

sam: Ah. So the SDK is naive: on refresh success it replays all queued requests rather than merging duplicates. For paginated prefetch that means multiple identical backend calls fire.

alejandra: Two quick ideas: 1) singleflight/dedupe by `(endpoint, cursor)` when inflight or about to be replayed, 2) honor a small jitter or serialized resume window after refresh to spread retries.

chao: I prefer singleflight + TTL. Simple map keyed by `(method,path,body.hash)` that returns the same promise for concurrent callers. TTL ~200ms should absorb refresh storms.

mira: Prototype patch for JS SDK: add `inflightMap` in transport layer. On request start: check key, if present return existing promise. On 401->refresh flow: instead of queue all requests, re-enqueue but `await inflightMap` to coalesce.

sam: Can we avoid changing semantics for non-paged endpoints? For example admin calls shouldn't be coalesced. Maybe add `coalesce: true|false` in request opts and default to `true` for prefetch/pagination only.

mira: Agreed. We'll default `coalesce` on the prefetcher and sampleapp commands. Also add feature flag `SDK_COALESCE_PREFETCH` env var for dogfood.

alejandra: Also add an opt-in on Python SDK. We should mirror behavior across SDKs. Please add a small integration test that simulates token refresh + concurrent cursor hits.

chao: Performance note: coalescing returns same response object to callers; we should clone or freeze to avoid mutating downstream state. Also watch memory leak on map key retention — use TTL eviction.

mira: I'll add TTL eviction + cloning response. Patch plan: JS PR with tests + sampleapp scenario + README note, then Py SDK PR mirroring logic. Rollout behind `SDK_COALESCE_PREFETCH` flag, enable in staging sampleapp for one week.

sam: Nice. Can you include a small perf bench? We want to ensure coalescing doesn't add latency on golden path. e.g., 50k requests run with and without coalesce.

mira: Yep — will run microbench and upstream the numbers.

devex-bot: Created issue #4321: "SDK: coalesce inflight paginated requests after token refresh to avoid client-side bursts" — link: https://redwood/issue/4321 :eyes: 

sam: Who's picking up the JS PR?

mira: I'll draft JS PR today. target branch `devex/coalesce-prefetch`.

alejandra: I'll sketch Python equivalent and test harness.

chao: I'll review and run perf bench on my rig.

mira: Quick question on tests — should we simulate a real token endpoint or mock? I'm leaning mocked token but run one integration with a local stub.

sam: Mock for unit; one integration with stub auth service is fine. Add CI job to run the integration on a small matrix.

mira: Will do. Also adding a note to sampleapp README about enabling `SDK_COALESCE_PREFETCH=true` for testing.

ci-bot: CI queue: scheduled integration run for branch devex/coalesce-prefetch — job id 98765.

sam: Awesome. Thanks Mira — this should fix a lot of onboarding 429 noise. :thumbsup: 

mira: Will post PR link when ready.

alejandra: :rocket:
